In practice this means a farm must spend real resources on every single alias, and that per-identity cost is what keeps the network honest at scale.. This holds because a newly minted alias starts worthless, so the attacker must first farm credibility on each one before it can swing a verdict. Consider a whisper as the anchor of the cost.
